% Checks cases a fix must not break: a \thechapter set in a book
% document's own env/document/before hook, which runs after the preamble.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\AddToHook{env/document/before}{\renewcommand\thechapter{\Alph{chapter}}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; \ref{second}.
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
Here \ref{second}.
\end{document}
